title: Prove Int cut lemmas by one split that z3 finds
summary: Int cut and coefficient-free Farkas lemmas are now proved in Lean by one case split whose form, constant, and multipliers z3 finds and Python and Lean check. With direct combinations for dense Farkas lemmas and serial elaboration from 5 MB, QF_LIA cut_lemma_02_002 verifies end to end for the first time.
